blocks.reason: A single-section full-height column. The upper door, a panel, the base door and drawers appear vertically aligned in one section. Continuity through the panel is assumed.

blocks.name: Main-wall right upper pair
blocks.contains: Two hanging upper doors on the main wall, right of the corner column.
blocks.reason: A separate hanging pair over the open void, not part of the column below.

blocks.name: Main-wall base doors (left)

blocks.reason: Three side-by-side doors within the position limit. Split from the right doors by the limit.

blocks.name: Main-wall base doors (right)
blocks.contains: Two base doors on the right part of the main base run, next to the filler.
blocks.reason: Two doors in one run section. The narrow filler is excluded and not treated as a front.

blocks.contains: Two wide horizontal upper fronts over the 180 run.
blocks.reason: A separate hanging unit with two lift-up fronts in one carcass.
